metadata.name: naim
metadata.description: NAIM — namespace protocol for AI agents on Solana

instructions.name: buy_with_sol
docs: Buy a name listed in SOL. The buyer pays `price` lamports: the fee goes
to the treasury wallet, the rest to the seller, both by native transfer.
The NameRecord is reassigned and the listing closed (rent to the seller).

instructions.name: buy_with_token
docs: Buy a name listed in $NAIM or USDC. The buyer pays `price` in the pay
mint: the fee (lower for $NAIM) goes to the treasury, the rest to the
seller. The NameRecord is reassigned to the buyer and the listing closed
(rent to the seller). Fails if the seller no longer owns the name.

accounts.name: market_treasury
docs: (needed as an account so init_if_needed can create that ATA).

accounts.name: pay_mint
docs: The pay mint — validated in the handler to match the listing's currency
($NAIM mint for CURRENCY_NAIM, usdc_mint for CURRENCY_USDC).

instructions.name: claim_rewards
docs: Claim accrued rewards without touching principal.

instructions.name: close_category
docs: Owner closes a category and reclaims its rent. Sub-names already minted
keep resolving; they simply no longer sit under a live category.

instructions.name: init_market_config
docs: One-time marketplace setup: pins the accepted USDC mint and the two fee
tiers ($NAIM cheaper than SOL/USDC). Admin-only (gated by Config.admin).

instructions.name: init_stake_pool
docs: One-time staking setup. Creates the pool + the principal vault. Rewards
are paid from the stakers vault (the tokenomics update's fee sink).

instructions.name: init_token_config
docs: One-time tokenomics setup. Pins the $NAIM mint, the per-tier fees (in
$NAIM) and the treasury/stakers/burn split, and creates the treasury and
stakers-vault token accounts. Admin-only.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Wallet that owns the treasury token account.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time protocol setup. Stores treasury + fee tiers + periods.

instructions.name: link_wallet
docs: Add a secondary wallet to the identity. Both the owner and the new
wallet must sign.

instructions.name: list_name
docs: List a name you own for sale at `price` in `currency` (0=$NAIM, 1=SOL,
2=USDC). The name stays yours until someone buys it; the Listing is your
on-chain authorization for the buy instruction to reassign the record.
One listing per name (PDA per name_hash).

instructions.name: place_rank_bid
docs: Bid $NAIM to boost one of your names for a capability. The bid is burned
100% (pure deflation, no receiver). Bids accumulate within an epoch; a
new epoch resets the amount. The off-chain ranker boosts names whose bid
was placed in the previous epoch (so positions are stable within an epoch).

instructions.name: register_category
docs: Register a category namespace (e.g. "defi.agent") — the creator owns it
and earns a 5% royalty on every sub-name minted beneath it. Fee in $NAIM.

instructions.name: register_name
docs: Register a new name. Creates its PDA, collects the tier fee, sets the
owner = resolver = payer. 1–4 char names are permanent (expiry 0).

accounts.name: stake_account
docs: Optional: the payer's stake position — grants a fee discount if present.
No seeds (so the client can omit it with `null`); the handler only honors
it when `stake_account.owner == payer`, and there is one stake PDA per
owner, so a forged or someone else's account grants no discount.

instructions.name: register_under_category
docs: Register a name directly under a category. Routes the 5% royalty (in
$NAIM) to the category owner; the remainder splits treasury/stakers/burn.

instructions.name: release_name
docs: Voluntarily release a name owned by the caller, refunding rent.

instructions.name: renew_name
docs: Extend a non-permanent name by one registration period. Collects the
tier fee. Extends from the later of `now` and the current expiry.

instructions.name: stake
docs: Stake $NAIM (locking it for `lock_seconds`). Harvests any pending rewards
first. A larger stake means a bigger registration discount.

instructions.name: transfer_category
docs: Transfer category ownership (the royalty stream) to a new pubkey.

instructions.name: transfer_name
docs: Transfer ownership to a new pubkey.

instructions.name: unlist_name
docs: Delist your name and reclaim the listing rent.

instructions.name: unstake
docs: Unstake principal after the lock expires; harvests pending rewards too.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin-only: update periods / treasury (and legacy fee fields) without redeploying.

instructions.name: update_listing
docs: Change the asking price of your listing (currency stays the same).

instructions.name: update_market_config
docs: Admin-only: tune the marketplace fees / USDC mint / treasury live.

instructions.name: update_metadata
docs: Change the AgentCard metadata URI.

instructions.name: update_resolver
docs: Change the wallet/program a name resolves to.

instructions.name: update_token_config
docs: Admin-only: update the tokenomics after init — fees, verify fee, split,
treasury and even the $NAIM mint. Mirrors init_token_config's accounts so
the treasury and stakers-vault token accounts for the (possibly new) mint
are ensured to exist.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Wallet that owns the treasury token account.

instructions.name: verify_name
docs: Set the verified flag in exchange for a payment to the treasury.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Caller is not the name authority

errors.name: NamePermanent
errors.msg: Name is permanent and cannot be renewed or released this way

errors.name: InvalidCategory
errors.msg: Category is invalid (must be like label.agent)

errors.name: NotUnderCategory
errors.msg: Name is not directly under this category

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Listing price must be greater than zero

errors.name: SelfPurchase
errors.msg: You cannot buy your own listing

errors.name: SellerNotOwner
errors.msg: The listing's seller no longer owns the name

errors.name: CurrencyMismatch
errors.msg: Wrong buy instruction for this listing's currency

errors.name: WrongPayMint
errors.msg: Payment mint does not match the listing's currency

types.name: CategoryRecord
docs: Category namespace (update/4). PDA seeds = [CATEGORY_SEED, category_hash].
The owner earns a royalty on every sub-name minted beneath the category.

fields.name: owner
docs: Current owner / authority of the category (transferable).

fields.name: royalty_bps
docs: Royalty on sub-name mints, in basis points (500 = 5%).

fields.name: sub_count
docs: Number of sub-names minted under this category.

fields.name: total_earned
docs: Cumulative $NAIM royalty paid out to the owner from sub-name mints.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: Config
docs: Singleton protocol config. PDA seeds = [CONFIG_SEED].
All economic values are set at `initialize` (from env via the deploy script),
never hardcoded in the program.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin authority (may update config later).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Wallet that receives all protocol fees.

fields.name: fee_1_4
docs: Registration fee for 1–4 char names (lamports). These are permanent.

fields.name: fee_5_9
docs: Registration fee for 5–9 char names (lamports).

fields.name: fee_10_plus
docs: Registration fee for 10+ char names (lamports).

fields.name: verify_fee
docs: Fee to set the verified flag (lamports).

fields.name: registration_period
docs: Registration / renewal period in seconds (e.g. 1 year).

fields.name: grace_period
docs: Grace period in seconds after expiry before public re-registration.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: Listing
docs: A secondary-market listing for a name. PDA seeds = [LISTING_SEED, name_hash].
The name stays owned by `seller` until bought; creating a listing is the
seller's on-chain authorization for the buy instruction to reassign the
NameRecord. The buy instruction re-checks ownership at purchase time.

fields.name: seller
docs: Seller — must own the name when it's listed and when it's bought.

fields.name: name_hash
docs: Hash of the listed name.

fields.name: currency
docs: Payment currency: 0 = $NAIM, 1 = SOL, 2 = USDC (see constants).

fields.name: price
docs: Asking price in the currency's base units (lamports / USDC / $NAIM).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp the listing was created.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: MarketConfig
docs: Singleton marketplace config. PDA seeds = [MARKET_CONFIG_SEED].
Holds the USDC mint accepted as a sale currency and the fee tiers. Kept in
its own PDA so the already-deployed Config / TokenConfig layouts are never
touched. Values come from env (set at init, tuned live), never hardcoded.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin authority (may update fees / usdc mint later).

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC SPL mint accepted as a listing/payment currency.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Wallet that receives marketplace fees (SOL natively; USDC/$NAIM via ATA).

fields.name: fee_naim_bps
docs: Fee on a $NAIM-priced sale (bps) — lower, to steer volume to $NAIM.

fields.name: fee_stable_bps
docs: Fee on a SOL- or USDC-priced sale (bps).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC SPL mint accepted as a sale currency.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Wallet that receives marketplace fees.

fields.name: fee_naim_bps
docs: Fee (bps) on a $NAIM sale — the cheaper tier.

fields.name: fee_stable_bps
docs: Fee (bps) on a SOL or USDC sale.

types.name: NameRecord
docs: On-chain record for a registered name.
PDA seeds = [SEED_PREFIX, sha256(name), TLD_AGENT].

fields.name: owner
docs: Current owner / authority of the name.

fields.name: resolver
docs: Wallet or program the name resolves to.

fields.name: metadata_uri
docs: URI of the AgentCard JSON manifest (Arweave/IPFS).

fields.name: expiry_timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of expiry. 0 = permanent.

fields.name: verified
docs: Set by the protocol on on-chain verification.

fields.name: linked_wallets
docs: Additional wallets associated with this identity.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: RankBid
docs: A sponsored ranking bid (update/5). PDA = [RANK_BID_SEED, name_hash, capability_hash].
The bid amount is burned (100%); this record just remembers how much a name
burned for a capability in a given epoch, so the off-chain ranker can boost it.

fields.name: amount
docs: $NAIM burned during `epoch`.

fields.name: epoch
docs: unix_timestamp / RANK_EPOCH_SECS at the time of the bid.

types.name: ReputationRecord
docs: Tamper-proof reputation inputs for a name (update/3). PDA seeds =
[REP_SEED, name_hash]. The protocol writes these at lifecycle events — they
can't be self-reported. Discovery ranks by a deterministic score computed
off these plus the NameRecord (verified, linked wallets, category depth).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp of first registration (account age).

fields.name: renew_count
docs: Number of renewals paid (commitment signal).

types.name: StakeAccount
docs: A user's stake position. PDA seeds = [STAKE_SEED, owner].

fields.name: amount
docs: Staked principal in $NAIM base units.

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: amount * acc_reward_per_share / ACC_PRECISION at last interaction.

fields.name: lock_end
docs: Unix timestamp before which `unstake` is rejected.

types.name: StakePool
docs: Singleton staking pool. PDA seeds = [STAKE_POOL_SEED]. Distributes the
stakers' share of fees (which accrues in the stakers vault from the
tokenomics update) via a reward-per-share accumulator (MasterChef-style).

fields.name: total_staked
docs: Total $NAIM currently staked (principal).

fields.name: acc_reward_per_share
docs: Accumulated reward per staked unit, scaled by ACC_PRECISION.

fields.name: last_reward_balance
docs: Rewards-vault balance already folded into the accumulator.

fields.name: stake_vault_bump
docs: Bump of the stake-vault authority (custodies principal).

types.name: TokenConfig
docs: Singleton tokenomics config. PDA seeds = [TOKEN_CONFIG_SEED].
Introduced in the tokenomics update: every protocol fee is paid in $NAIM,
then split treasury / stakers-vault / burn. Kept separate from `Config` so
the already-deployed `Config` account layout is never broken.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin authority (may update fees / split later).

fields.name: naim_mint
docs: The $NAIM SPL mint that fees are paid in (and burned from).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Wallet that owns the treasury $NAIM token account.

fields.name: fee_1_4
docs: Registration fee for 1–4 char names ($NAIM base units). Permanent names.

fields.name: fee_5_9
docs: Registration fee for 5–9 char names ($NAIM base units).

fields.name: fee_10_plus
docs: Registration fee for 10+ char names ($NAIM base units).

fields.name: verify_fee
docs: Fee to set the verified flag ($NAIM base units).

fields.name: treasury_bps
docs: Share of every fee sent to the treasury (basis points).

fields.name: stakers_bps
docs: Share of every fee sent to the stakers vault (basis points).

fields.name: burn_bps
docs: Share of every fee burned (basis points). The three must sum to 10_000.

fields.name: total_burned
docs: Running total of $NAIM burned by the protocol (stat).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for this account.

fields.name: vault_bump
docs: PDA bump for the stakers-vault authority.

fields.name: fee_1_4
docs: Per-tier fees in $NAIM base units.

fields.name: treasury_bps
docs: Fee split in basis points; the three must sum to 10_000.
